svg.title: Commuters buy tea and call work during the honest waiting interval.
svg.desc: Instead of standing rigidly beneath a false exact time, commuters use the range to buy tea and make work calls. Vale observes that uncertainty has produced usable time.
svg.text: Page 28, panel 2 · Observational medium shot towards the west tea stall

text.tspan: The honest range lets commuters use the wait rather
than guard against an invented minute.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
